items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: So I spoke to Fletcher, and I said, "Fletcher, it's the first time I've been here; this city looks very worn down."

ctx.x: Linton Garner, that's right. We played the Cotton Club in Cincinnati, you know, and they were playing in Covington across the river. So I spoke to Fletcher, and I said, "Fletcher, it's the first time I've been here; this city looks very worn down." He said, "Yes, I call it Cinci-Nasty." [LAUGHS] He was staying with a girl named Muriel or somebody.
